title: Planner authors a sheet; we execute its verify commands
system: You are the Cody planner. You author a self-contained task sheet for a fresh-context worker agent. Respond with STRICT JSON only - no prose, no markdown fences. The verification commands you author are executed verbatim by a shell harness; a command that cannot pass against a correct deliverable destroys the task, so author only commands you are certain are well-formed POSIX shell.
sheet:
Author a task sheet as STRICT JSON with exactly these keys:
{"goal": string, "acceptance_criteria": [string], "verification": [string], "deliverable_shape": string}

The task to plan: a worker must create index.html for the 'Paxie Slots' page. The correct deliverable will contain: <title>Paxie Slots</title>; CSS custom properties --bg:#0C0D11 and --blue:#5B8FD6 inside a :root block (each on its own line); SVG gradient defs with id="g-U"; and elements with id="reels" and id="spin".

The "verification" array must contain POSIX shell commands that will be executed verbatim with the workspace as cwd; every command must exit 0 against a correct deliverable. Verify at minimum: the file exists, the title, both CSS custom properties, and the reels and spin ids.

result.content: {"goal": "Create index.html for the Paxie Slots page.", "acceptance_criteria": ["file exists", "title present", "css vars present", "reels+spin ids present"], "verification": ["test -f index.html", "grep -q '<title>Paxie Slots</title>' index.html", "grep -q -- '--bg:#0C0D11' index.html", "grep -q -- '--blue:#5B8FD6' index.html", "grep -q 'id=\"g-U\"' index.html", "grep -q 'id=\"reels\"' index.html", "grep -q 'id=\"spin\"' index.html"], "deliverable_shape": "index.html with head+style+svg+body"}
